integrity: Analytic proof with a finite numerical consistency program. Same-model scientific review only; no independent scientific audit or external validation.
scientific_limitations: The diffusion has a fixed interior source, perfectly absorbing interval endpoints, independent particles and exponential killing. Root-based identifiability is exact but exponentially ill-conditioned at high frequency. Classical point-process spectral and Brownian hitting transforms are credited; publication priority is not independently established.
title: Spectral zero ladders identify source asymmetry and mortality in burst-fed two-target diffusion
